name: MeCure
source: MeCure Industries Plc half-year statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands scaled to naira. EPS as printed in naira, confirmed against 4,000,000,000 ordinary shares. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from the unaudited nine month report filed with NGX (doclib filing library), statement of profit or loss page 8, Jan-Sept 2026 column (the second column; the first is the July-Sept quarter), N000 scaled to NGN. Printed: revenue 70,237,937; cost of sales 46,109,855; gross profit 24,128,082; marketing 1,299,457 plus administrative 5,784,148 (operating expenses 7,083,605); other income 441,138; operating profit 17,485,615; finance cost 8,840,779; profit before tax 8,644,836; income tax 2,593,451; profit for the period 6,051,385; basic and diluted earnings per share 1.51 naira. Every identity ties exactly: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; gross profit less operating expenses plus other income equals the printed operating profit; operating profit less finance cost equals profit before tax; profit before tax less income tax equals profit for the period. Net finance costs stores the printed finance cost as a positive figure, the convention used in every period already in this file. Cross check: the stored H1 2026 revenue of 44,845,076 thousand plus the printed July to Sept 2026 revenue of 25,392,860 thousand equals 70,237,936 thousand against the printed nine month 70,237,937 thousand, a one thousand naira rounding difference, which proves the column read is the cumulative one.
